'''2017 MPC Reid Smith DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Reid Smith]] at [[2017 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Reid Smith]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open BHBM Smith DS 2017 MPC.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
